verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Unreal's renderer includes Lumen for real-time global illumination/reflections and general praise for lighting quality, supporting the GI/rendering claim, but the evidence pack lacks first-party documentation or hands-on confirmation of PBR material workflows, shadow systems, or the post-processing pipeline explicitly. missing for 10: explicit docs/evidence on PBR material editor, shadow mapping/ray-traced shadows, and post-process volume/effects stack.
